visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a large white cake box decorated with soft white feathers. A gold-colored topper reading "LEBABY" sits atop a spherical pink and gold cake. The box is tied with a white ribbon featuring the text "échapper Cake Studio" in black lettering. The lighting is warm and indoor. (2) A young woman with long, dark straight hair and bangs, wearing a black sleeveless lace dress, appears in the frame. She sits in a private room with wood-paneled walls and unboxes the cake, carefully untying the white ribbons with her hands while smiling warmly. (3) The woman celebrates with the unboxed cake. A blue LED light ring glows around the cake's base, illuminating the surrounding white feathers. She claps her hands rhythmically and then closes her eyes, pressing her palms together in a prayer-like gesture while maintaining a happy facial expression. (4) Using a small wooden mallet, the woman gently taps and breaks the top of the pink spherical chocolate shell. This reveals a beautifully decorated cake inside, featuring several fresh pink and white roses and a small circular edible photo of the woman herself in the center. (5) She pulls on a small pink ribbon protruding from the cake. A long, vertical strip of transparent plastic sleeves containing numerous 100 RMB banknotes is pulled out, extending high above the cake. She holds the money strip up, laughing and looking delighted, as the camera zooms out slightly to show the full length of the cash.
